title: Configuration question
description: A choice question whose options are gearset configurations, shown as cards with their diagram. A fork of the quiz block: same scoring, feedback, saved state and SCORM records.
instructions: Use with a plan question (questionRef) whose options describe configurations; add one diagram per option id (images/config-<held>-<input>.svg, generated by generators/figures.mjs). The diagram supports the option text and never shows the output's direction or speed.

legend.description: Key of the symbols of the diagrams.

figure.description: Diagram of the configuration (decorative: the option text says it).
